title: The Concept of Cognitive Dissonance
text:
Cognitive dissonance describes the mental stress experienced by an individual who holds two or more contradictory beliefs, ideas, or values. This psychological discomfort motivates the person to change one or more conflicting cognitions until internal consistency is restored.

Resolution of this conflict does not always involve changing the behavior itself; often, the easier route involves altering the perceived importance of the conflicting belief or adding new justifications that reconcile the discrepancy.
